c1-mat-0009: Jesus made a long walk to meet John. Matthew 3:13 says where He started.
c1-mat-0010: John was surprised to see Jesus there. Look at Matthew 3:14.
c1-mat-0011: Jesus had a reason for stepping in. Let's read Matthew 3:15 together.
c1-mat-0012: Coming up out of the water is a big moment. I'd know. See Matthew 3:16.
c1-mrk-0005: I know plenty of waters, friend. Let Mark 1:9 tell you this one.
c1-mrk-0006: Everyone heard that voice that day. Listen close in Mark 1:11.
c1-luk-0009: Luke noticed something quiet and lovely here. Peek at Luke 3:21.
c1-luk-0010: Heaven came close that day. Luke 3:22 paints the picture.
c1-mrk-0007: Down by the shore, two brothers were busy. Mark 1:16 shows us.
c1-mrk-0008: Jesus called, and two brothers had a big choice. Read Mark 1:17 and Mark 1:18.
c1-mrk-0009: Two more brothers sat fixing nets in a boat. Mark 1:19 names their dad.
c1-mrk-0010: Up on the mountain, Jesus picked His team. Count along in Mark 3:14.
c1-mrk-0011: Sometimes a friend gives you a new name. Mark 3:16 has this one.
c1-mrk-0012: Jesus had big plans for His friends. Mark 3:14 tells what they were.
c1-luk-0011: I've had some long nights out on the water myself. See Luke 5:5.
c1-luk-0012: Those partners had their hands full! Luke 5:7 shows what came next.
c1-luk-0013: A hurt man lay by the road, waiting. Luke 10:33 shows who stopped.
c1-luk-0014: Kind hands got to work on that hurt man. Look at Luke 10:34.
c1-luk-0015: A good shepherd keeps careful count. Luke 15:4 tells his number.
c1-luk-0016: One sinner turning back is a big deal in heaven. Read Luke 15:7.
c1-luk-0017: That young man was far from home with empty pockets. See Luke 15:15.
c1-luk-0018: A dad kept watching the road for his boy. Luke 15:20 is a sweet one.
c1-mat-0013: Storms test every house, friend. Matthew 7:24 tells where the wise man built.
c1-mat-0014: A farmer tossed seed all over. Matthew 13:8 shows which seed grew.
c1-mat-0015: Big crowds were gathering to hear Jesus. Matthew 5:1 says where He went.
c1-mat-0016: Jesus made a lovely promise to the pure in heart. Read Matthew 5:8.
c1-mat-0017: Peacemakers get a special name from Jesus. Let's read Matthew 5:9 together.
c1-mat-0018: Jesus loved word pictures. Matthew 5:13 has a good one.
c1-mat-0019: Some things are too big to tuck away. Matthew 5:14 tells one.
c1-mat-0020: There's a reason behind every bit of light. Matthew 5:16 explains.
c1-mat-0021: Jesus taught His friends how to talk to God. Peek at Matthew 6:11.
c1-mat-0022: Being forgiven sure feels good. Matthew 6:12 tells what comes with it.
c1-luk-0019: Two sisters, one special guest. Luke 10:39 shows where Mary was.
c1-luk-0020: Martha's house was a busy place that day. Look at Luke 10:40.
c1-luk-0021: Zacchaeus had a job folks talked about. Luke 19:2 names it.
c1-luk-0022: Zacchaeus had more than one problem that day. Luke 19:3 tells it.
c1-luk-0023: Zacchaeus found a clever way to see. Luke 19:4 shows how.
c1-luk-0024: Jesus came with a mission. Luke 19:10 says it plain as day.
c1-mrk-0013: Little ones were trying to reach Jesus. Mark 10:14 shows how He felt.
c1-mrk-0014: Jesus scooped those children right up. Read Mark 10:16 to see what followed.
c1-luk-0025: Jesus sent two friends on an errand. Luke 19:30 tells what to fetch.
c1-luk-0026: Jesus gave them just the right words. Luke 19:31 has them.
c1-luk-0027: What a welcome for the King! Luke 19:36 shows what the people did.
c1-luk-0028: Some folks wanted that crowd quiet. Jesus had an answer in Luke 19:40.
c1-jhn-0016: Coming out of a dark place is a story worth telling. See John 12:17.
c1-jhn-0017: The crowd could hardly hold it in! John 12:13 has their first cry.
c1-jhn-0018: News travels fast in a crowd. John 12:18 tells why they came.
c1-jhn-0019: The Pharisees were grumbling among themselves. Listen in at John 12:19.
c1-luk-0029: A big meal needs helpers. Luke 22:8 names the two Jesus sent.
c1-luk-0030: Jesus gave His friends a clue to follow in the city. See Luke 22:10.
c1-luk-0031: Jesus broke the bread with a reason in mind. Let's read Luke 22:19 together.
c1-luk-0032: After supper, Jesus lifted the cup. Hear His words in Luke 22:20.
c1-mat-0023: After supper, Jesus went off to pray. Matthew 26:36 names the spot.
c1-mat-0024: Jesus' heart was heavy that night. Matthew 26:38 shows what He asked.
c1-mat-0025: Jesus came back from praying again. Take a look at Matthew 26:43.
c1-mat-0026: That was the bravest prayer ever prayed. Read Matthew 26:39.
c1-act-0001: Jesus left His friends a big promise. Acts 1:8 tells what they'd get.
c1-act-0002: His friends stood staring upward. Acts 1:9 shows what they saw.
c1-act-0003: Two men in white had good news. Read Acts 1:11.
c1-act-0004: The friends were all together when heaven broke in. Listen to Acts 2:2.
c1-act-0005: Something wonderful rested on each believer. Acts 2:3 describes it.
c1-act-0006: The crowd asked Peter a short question. Acts 2:38 has his answer.
c1-act-0007: That day the family of believers grew. Acts 2:41 gives the count.
c1-act-0008: Those first believers stuck together. Acts 2:42 shows what they kept doing.
c1-act-0009: The temple gates each had a name. Acts 3:10 tells this one.
c1-act-0010: That man had waited by the gate a long time. See Acts 3:2.
c1-act-0011: Peter stopped for the man everyone passed by. Read Acts 3:4.
c1-act-0012: Peter had no coins, but he had something better. See Acts 3:6.
c1-act-0013: Feet that never worked were suddenly strong! Acts 3:8 shows what happened.
c1-act-0014: Peter sat in a locked-up place that night. Acts 12:6 tells how he was held.
c1-act-0015: Nobody is ever too locked up for God. See who came in Acts 12:7.
c1-act-0016: Friends were praying when a knock came. Acts 12:13 shows who went.
c1-act-0017: Saul was on a road with mean plans. Acts 9:3 shows what stopped him.
c1-act-0018: Saul's trip took a big turn. Let's read Acts 9:4 together.
c1-act-0019: Saul had to wait it out in Damascus. Acts 9:9 tells how long.
c1-act-0020: God gave a man in Damascus a big job. Acts 9:10 names him.
c1-act-0021: A kind touch changed things for Saul. Look at Acts 9:18.
c1-act-0022: I know a thing about tight, dark spots. See midnight in Acts 16:25.
c1-act-0023: Midnight in that prison got exciting. Acts 16:26 has the whole story.
c1-act-0024: The jailer asked the biggest question of all. Acts 16:31 has the answer.
c1-rom-0001: Here's one worth reading slow, friend. Romans 3:23 is waiting.
c1-rom-0002: God makes folks right with Him. Romans 3:24 tells how He does it.
c1-rom-0003: Christ came right on time. Romans 5:6 says who He came for.
c1-rom-0004: Christ came for us just as we were. Romans 5:8 says what that shows.
c1-rom-0005: Everybody likes a good gift. Romans 6:23 tells the best one.
c1-rom-0006: Romans 10:10 talks about believing and speaking up. Read it close.
c1-rom-0007: Romans 10:13 is a wide-open welcome. Let it sink in.
c1-rom-0008: Faith has to start somewhere. Romans 10:17 tells how it comes.
c1-eph-0001: Nobody earns their way to God. Ephesians 2:9 tells what that means.
c1-eph-0002: Ephesians 2:10 says something special about you, friend. Read it.
c1-eph-0003: Ephesians 4:32 is about treating folks right. Read every word.
c1-eph-0004: Here's a verse just for kids and their folks. See Ephesians 6:1.
c1-eph-0005: A promise is tied to this rule. Read Ephesians 6:2 and Ephesians 6:3.
c1-eph-0006: God gives His people armor for the battle. Ephesians 6:17 names the sword.
c1-php-0001: Worry pulls a fellow down deep. Philippians 4:6 shows the way up.
c1-php-0002: Strength from Christ goes a long way. Fill in the blank with Philippians 4:13.
c1-psa-0001: Psalm 1:3 paints a picture of a happy heart. Soak it in.
c1-psa-0002: David stopped to wonder at God's work. Psalm 8:3 tells what he named.
c1-psa-0003: Even the heavens have something to say. Listen to Psalm 19:1.
c1-psa-0004: David knew just who the LORD was to him. Read Psalm 23:1.
c1-psa-0005: David ends his song with a promise. Psalm 23:6 tells what follows him.
c1-psa-0006: God speaks right to His people in Psalm 46:10. Give it a listen.
c1-psa-0007: There's a right way to walk into God's gates. Psalm 100:4 tells how.
c1-psa-0008: The psalmist treasured God's words. Psalm 119:111 says why.
c1-pro-0001: Every good thing has a starting place. Proverbs 1:7 tells about this one.
c1-pro-0002: Proverbs 1:8 talks about listening at home. See who it names.
c1-pro-0003: Trusting God with your whole heart is a big choice. Read Proverbs 3:5.
c1-pro-0004: Keep God close, and there's a promise for you. Proverbs 3:6 holds it.
c1-pro-0005: We give God our best because He's so good. Proverbs 3:9 tells more.
c1-pro-0006: A kind word can work wonders. Proverbs 15:1 shows what it does.
c1-pro-0007: A true friend is worth a lot, friend. Proverbs 17:17 says when they love.
c1-pro-0008: I learned some lessons the long way round. Proverbs 22:6 is about young ones.
c1-dan-0002: Daniel stood out in that king's court. Daniel 6:3 tells why.
c1-dan-0003: A sneaky new rule was signed. Daniel 6:7 shows how long it lasted.
c1-dan-0004: Daniel kept right on praying. Look at Daniel 6:10.
c1-dan-0005: Jealous men went digging for trouble. Daniel 6:4 tells why they came up empty.
c1-dan-0006: The king was worried for his friend. Hear his words in Daniel 6:16.
c1-dan-0007: That was one long night for the king. Daniel 6:18 tells how he spent it.
c1-dan-0008: The king had a brand new rule. Daniel 6:26 shows who it honored.
c1-dan-0009: That gold statue was huge! Daniel 3:1 tells where it stood.
c1-dan-0010: The music started, and everyone had orders. Daniel 3:5 spells them out.
c1-dan-0011: The king called into the flames. Hear what he said in Daniel 3:26.
c1-dan-0012: Those three young men were brave as can be. Read Daniel 3:17.
c1-dan-0013: The king was boiling mad. Daniel 3:19 shows how hot he made it.
c1-dan-0014: The king peeked in and got a big surprise. Look at Daniel 3:25.
c1-dan-0015: Everyone crowded around those three. Daniel 3:27 tells what they noticed.
c1-dan-0016: The king changed his tune that day. Daniel 3:30 tells what he did.
c1-bib-0001: Every big story has to open somewhere. John 1:1 points us there.
c1-bib-0002: The Bible's books come in families. John 1:17 gives a clue to one.
c1-bib-0003: Four books tell about Jesus' life. Mark 1:1 hints at their family name.
c1-bib-0004: Every story needs a next chapter. John 21:25 is where John closes.
c1-bib-0005: Jesus knew His Bible well. Luke 20:42 shows a book He named.
c1-bib-0006: Romans 1:7 is full of grace and peace. Give it a read.
c1-bib-0007: Jesus walked two friends through the Scriptures. Let's read Luke 24:27 together.
c1-bib-0008: God's glory filled the tent in Exodus 40:34. Then the story turns the page.
c1-dan-0001: Daniel spent the night somewhere dark and scary. I know that feeling. Read Daniel 6:22.
